content: WoW community tool monetization patterns: WoWAnalyzer runs Patreon ($2/mo = ad-free + Discord perks + name color), site is ad-supported by default. Warcraft Logs: ad-supported free tier + tiered subs ($2-5+). Wipefest: Patreon ($3/mo) unlocks Player Score Grid + non-kill data. tbc-audit.com: direct EUR subscription tiers (3.99/8.99), no visible ads. Logs by HLTG: freemium + optional Patreon, core stays free. Pattern: ads OR small ($2-5/mo) subscription unlocking power-user/guild features, not both aggressively; ad-free is itself sold as a perk.
